AC0001.Name: Custom_Tile
AC0001.Description: Alliance captain XP card. Edit the name and XP tracks here; the ship tracker follows the name and skill.
AC0001.LuaScript:
-- Point-board state v2. Descriptions remain user-editable; state is stored as JSON.
local boardSaved = nil
local limits = {Elite=6,Skill=14,Crew=10,Weapon=10,Tech=10}
local slotIndex = {None=0,Crew=1,Weapon=2,Tech=3}
local categories = {"Elite","Skill","Crew","Weapon","Tech"}
local positions = {
    Elite={"114 -55 -2","114 -55 -22","46 -55 -22","26 -55 -22","-60 -55 -22","-78 -55 -22","-96 -55 -22"},
    Skill={114,96,78,61,46,28,9,-9,-27,-45,-60,-78,-96,-114,-132,-141},
    Crew={104,82,58,33,8,-14,-40,-62,-85,-110,-134},
    Weapon={104,82,58,33,8,-14,-40,-62,-85,-110,-134},
    Tech={104,82,58,33,8,-14,-40,-62,-85,-110,-134}
}
local marker = {Elite="E0",Skill="S0",Crew="C0",Weapon="W0",Tech="T0"}
local row = {Skill=-30,Crew=32,Weapon=58,Tech=83}
ExpansionOne, ExpansionTwo = "None", "None"
totalPoints = 0

local function bounded(value, maximum)
    local number=tonumber(value)
    if not number or number~=number or number==math.huge or number==-math.huge then return 0 end
    return math.max(0,math.min(maximum,math.floor(number)))
end
local function decode(saved)
    if type(saved)~="string" or saved=="" then return nil end
    local ok,value=pcall(JSON.decode,saved)
    if ok and type(value)=="table" and value.version==2 then return value end
    return nil
end
local function legacyState()
    local text=self.getDescription() or ""
    -- Read the last five fields so legacy names may contain commas or be empty.
    local name,e,s,c,w,t=text:match("^(.*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*),([^,]*)$")
    return {name=name or self.getName() or "Name",Elite=e,Skill=s,Crew=c,Weapon=w,Tech=t}
end
local function render()
    totalPoints=0
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do
        local value=bounded(_G[category.."Points"],limits[category])
        _G[category.."Points"]=value
        totalPoints=totalPoints+value
        local position=positions[category][value+1]
        if category~="Elite" then position=tostring(position).." "..row[category].." -22" end
        self.UI.setAttribute(marker[category],"position",position)
    end
    self.UI.setAttribute("Name","text",self.getName())
    self.UI.setAttribute("Cost","text",tostring(totalPoints))
    self.UI.setAttribute("ExpansionOne","value",tostring(slotIndex[ExpansionOne] or 0))
    self.UI.setAttribute("ExpansionTwo","value",tostring(slotIndex[ExpansionTwo] or 0))
end
function SaveState()
    local state={version=2,name=self.getName(),ExpansionOne=ExpansionOne,ExpansionTwo=ExpansionTwo,memory=memory}
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do state[category]=bounded(_G[category.."Points"],limits[category]) end
    boardSaved=JSON.encode(state)
    self.script_state=boardSaved
    if STA2E_CaptainNotify then STA2E_CaptainNotify() end
    return boardSaved
end
function LoadState()
    local state=decode(boardSaved) or legacyState()
    memory=type(state.memory)=="table" and state.memory or {}
    self.setName(type(state.name)=="string" and state.name or "Name")
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do _G[category.."Points"]=bounded(state[category],limits[category]) end
    ExpansionOne=slotIndex[state.ExpansionOne] and state.ExpansionOne or "None"
    ExpansionTwo=slotIndex[state.ExpansionTwo] and state.ExpansionTwo or "None"
    render()
    SaveState()
end
function onLoad(saved)
    boardSaved=saved
    self.clearContextMenu()
    self.addContextMenuItem("Load",LoadState)
    LoadState()
end
function onSave() return SaveState() end
function nameUpdate(player,value)
    self.setName(tostring(value or ""))
    render(); SaveState()
end
local function adjust(category,amount)
    _G[category.."Points"]=bounded((_G[category.."Points"] or 0)+amount,limits[category])
    render(); SaveState()
end
function EliteUp() adjust("Elite",1) end
function EliteDown() adjust("Elite",-1) end
function SkillUp() adjust("Skill",1) end
function SkillDown() adjust("Skill",-1) end
function CrewUp() adjust("Crew",1) end
function CrewDown() adjust("Crew",-1) end
function WeaponUp() adjust("Weapon",1) end
function WeaponDown() adjust("Weapon",-1) end
function TechUp() adjust("Tech",1) end
function TechDown() adjust("Tech",-1) end
-- Expansion controls record the two additional slot types; they do not alter costs.
function option1Selected(player,value)
    if slotIndex[value]==nil then return end
    ExpansionOne=value; render(); SaveState()
end
function option2Selected(player,value)
    if slotIndex[value]==nil then return end
    ExpansionTwo=value; render(); SaveState()
end

-- Keep the original point board's UI, track limits, and v2 state format.
-- Add ship association and a read-only snapshot for Remodulated's tracker.
memory={}
local captainObservedName=nil
local captainNextNameCheck=0
function STA2E_CaptainSnapshot()
    local state={name=self.getName(),skill=2+math.floor(bounded(SkillPoints,limits.Skill)/2),xp=0,tracks={},ExpansionOne=ExpansionOne,ExpansionTwo=ExpansionTwo}
    for _,category in ipairs(categories) do
        state.tracks[category]=bounded(_G[category.."Points"],limits[category])
        state.xp=state.xp+state.tracks[category]
    end
    return state
end
function STA2E_SetMemory(value)
    memory=value or {}
    SaveState()
end
function STA2E_CaptainNotify()
    captainObservedName=self.getName()
    self.value=totalPoints
    if memory.instanceId and memory.role=="upgrade" then
        pcall(function() Global.call("STA2E_AllianceCaptainChanged",{object=self,snapshot=STA2E_CaptainSnapshot()}) end)
    end
end
function onUpdate()
    if Time.time<captainNextNameCheck then return end
    captainNextNameCheck=Time.time+0.5
    if captainObservedName~=self.getName() then render();SaveState() end
end
